title: Capability Genesis Loop over the Egregore parts board
problem: Observation: every piece of a capability-formation cycle exists in the kernel (parts board with shadow/bind/rollback, 11-rung strategy tree, spider-web audit, 7-tier verifier capsule, genome registry, whole-body closure) but nothing connects standing cognition's own recorded failures to a governed formation cycle; candidate sets are fixed by code. Inference: this is the residual CapabilityDeficit INTENT-0030 names. Proposal: egregore/genesis.py connects them with no new authority.
baseline: PR #129 head 8c62616: PartsBoard (register/shadow/bind/detach/rollback through Gate) and local_draft_part; swapping a part is a human-driven act with no deficit trigger, no ladder record, no aggregated trial evidence, no genome handoff.

alternatives.name: Reuse evolution.ClosureLoop directly for part changes
alternatives.description: Treat each candidate part as a StrategyBranch and run ClosureLoop.run_cycle with a spider-web audit and compiled experiment.
disadvantages: ClosureLoop requires a complete eight-side SpiderWebAudit per cycle, built for venture architectures, so every part swap would need fabricated market sides
no notion of slots, shadow bindings or grant-bound dossiers
alternatives.revival_evidence: If a future ClosureLoop variant accepts internal-change audits, genesis decisions should emit EvolutionCapsules through it.

alternatives.name: Literal developmental substrate (MICA/CDPE cells and fields) as the formation mechanism
alternatives.description: Grow replacement parts through local-rule developmental programs in developmental/.
disadvantages: no evidence it beats shadow trial plus human ratification for choosing between concrete implementations
adds a simulation the Gate cannot verify
alternatives.revival_evidence: A benchmark where a local-rule mechanism selects or repairs a cognition part better than ladder-ordered shadow trials on a strong baseline.

alternatives.name: External workflow engine or feature-flag service (LaunchDarkly-style) for part rollout
alternatives.description: Use a commodity flag/canary service to stage parts.
disadvantages: bindings would then be authorized outside the Consequence Gate
no ledger lineage; cloud dependency conflicts with open-source-first
alternatives.revival_evidence: A self-hosted flag service with signed, ledger-anchored decisions that the Gate can consume as evidence.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Parts remain swappable by hand (PR #129). Deficits are noticed by humans reading cycles; no ladder discipline is enforced; retained parts are not reusable genomes; nothing compounds.
disadvantages: founder goal (adaptive, compounding capability formation) unmet
anti-literalization gate stays prose instead of an executable check

roles.position: The request is metaphor-dense; compiled effects are preserved (formation on verified deficit, ladder-first resourcefulness, compounding reuse, lawful leverage). 'Dominance' and 'substrate' are translated, not literalized, and the translation is recorded in INTENT-0031 conflicts.
material_concerns: Market-level spider-web hegemony cannot be claimed without a venture transaction
Must not silently shrink the destination: the external wedge is recorded as open

roles.position: The loop composes existing contracts (PartsBoard, VerifierRecord, failure classes, GenomeRegistry, WholeBodyClosureController) and owns only case state. One new public method on PartsBoard (resolved). No contract changed.
material_concerns: Dossier hash includes rollback_target, so unrelated board changes invalidate a review; acceptable because it forces re-reading
Genome version is a part-id slice; collisions improbable but not impossible

roles.position: Attacks run: forged retained decision, stale dossier, hypothesis-only verifier, thin trial, doctrinal refusal in trial, foreign shadow results, new_architecture with cheaper candidate, missing cheaper rungs. Each guard was removed in turn and a test failed each time.
material_concerns: A human can still record a false ladder ('searched_none' without searching); the loop records who said so but cannot verify the search
A proposer that produces plausible but wrong content passes trial if evaluators agree; bounded by required Guardian/Treasury, not by this loop

roles.position: Cases rebuild from the ledger; code must be re-registered after restart and unresolved parts are reported, not guessed. Detector thresholds are constructor arguments.
material_concerns: Detaching a stale shadow still needs a grant
Thresholds should probably become ratified configuration

roles.position: All evidence is sandbox tier (unit tests with real Gate, ledger, passports; fake proposers). No real model, no real signals, no external effect. Victim protection compiles to: required evaluators cannot be emptied, doctrinal refusal blocks retain, shadows have no influence, rollback exists, every transition names an actor.
material_concerns: Underlying-effect verification (a real deficit resolved by a real local model) has not happened
License field in the dossier is 'unresolved' by design and must be filled before any external use

evidence.claim: Genesis loop retains a candidate only through a Gate-granted binding and registers a genome
evidence.finding: passes; binding record present, genome registered, case RETAINED survives restart

evidence.reference: mutation run: 8 guards removed one at a time
evidence.finding: each removal failed at least one test; restored file passes 10/10

evidence.claim: No regression in the kernel suite
evidence.finding: see docs/CAPABILITY_GENESIS_LOOP.md §Evidence for counts; the two continuity tests fail identically on main in this shallow clone

counterevidence.claim: The loop achieves the founder's destination (adaptive, compounding capability formation in reality)
counterevidence.finding: unproven: no real deficit has been resolved by a real local model; this is a sandbox-tier mechanism
not achieved: items 2, 6, 8, 9, 11, 15, 17 unresolved at market level; internal mapping only

pass_1.intended_outcome: Standing cognition's verified failures become governed, evidence-bearing formation cases whose retained outcomes are reusable, without any software gaining authority.

advantages.amplified_value: Every future capability in the Egregore carries a machine-checked record that cheaper real mechanisms were considered first; this is institutional memory that compounds and deters framework sprawl.

advantages.statement: Dossier is content-addressed and bound to the grant review
advantages.amplified_value: What a human approved is exactly what binds; this is the proof-to-settlement link inside the institution.

advantages.statement: Retained parts become genomes and rung-1 candidates
advantages.amplified_value: Each genesis lowers the cost of the next; formation history becomes a portable asset for other organs.
Stopping always succeeds; deterrence against runaway formation is structural.

disadvantages.statement: Ladder outcomes are self-reported by the proposer
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Record proposed_by on the case and in the ledger; the dossier shows the ladder to the ratifying human; future work can attach search evidence per rung.
Decision is EXPERIMENT, not RETAIN: the first live shadow case against a real local model is the gate before any claim.
Expose as constructor arguments now; propose ratified configuration in a follow-up.

disadvantages.statement: Shadow detach requires a grant, so a stale shadow costs budget until a human acts
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Shadow budget is bounded by its own ResourceGovernor; recorded as unresolved question in INTENT-0031.

disadvantages.statement: Dossier hash sensitivity to unrelated board changes
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Kept: forces re-reading; cheap for the human, expensive for a replay attacker.

comparisons.baseline: PR #129 parts board alone: manual swaps, no trigger, no ladder, no reuse.
comparisons.do_nothing: Founder goal unmet; anti-literalization stays prose.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: A deficit detector that only writes ledger records for humans to read; no case lifecycle. Rejected because retained parts would still not be bound to reviewed evidence or become genomes.
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: Route every part change through evolution.ClosureLoop. Rejected for now because it demands a full eight-side market audit per internal change.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: This PR as draft; first live case runs in shadow only; revert removes genesis.py and one PartsBoard method.

rejected_alternatives.name: Literal MICA/CDPE developmental substrate
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: INTENT-0030 regressed literal framing; no evidence of advantage over shadow trial for choosing implementations
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: benchmark win over ladder-ordered shadow trials on a strong baseline

rejected_alternatives.name: Commodity feature-flag service
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: authority would leave the Gate; cloud dependency
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: self-hosted, ledger-anchored flag decisions consumable by the Gate

rejected_alternatives.name: Automatic promotion from shadow scores
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: SR-INTENT-3 and constitutional invariants: no component may authorize its own promotion
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: none within current authority; would require an explicit founder ruling

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked the strengthened design as if deployed: forged and replayed records, hypothesis-only verifiers, false ladders, thin trials, foreign evidence, unrelated-change hash churn, restart with missing code, and the temptation to claim market hegemony.

new_weaknesses.statement: Three ledger records and two grants per formation
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Accepted: the grants are the self-promotion bound; stop directions and observation need none.

new_weaknesses.statement: A proposer may mark rungs 'searched_none' without searching
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Actor recorded; dossier exposes it to the ratifier; follow-up may require per-rung evidence refs.
Documented in egregore/README with one table; states are the minimum for restart-safe lifecycle.

new_weaknesses.statement: Detector tuned to this runtime's failure dict shape
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Shape is the runtime's own contract (CognitionCycle.failures); tests pin it.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Human ratifier sees the ladder and who recorded it; verification of search is a follow-up
First live shadow case against a real local model decides retain/regress of the loop itself
Constructor arguments suffice for sandbox; ratified configuration later
Bounded by shadow ResourceGovernor; stop-should-be-free question recorded
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a stale shadow consumes a material budget

pass_2.final_design: egregore/genesis.py as implemented: DeficitDetector over recorded cycles; CapabilityGenesis cases with ladder-ordered admission, Gate-granted shadow and bind via PartsBoard, trial aggregation from shadow_result records, content-addressed dossier, verifier-tier ratification with doctrinal-refusal and whole-body checks, genome registration and rung-1 reuse. One added PartsBoard.resolved(). No change to runtime, Gate, grants or contracts.

residual_risks.risk: Sandbox-only evidence mistaken for achieved capability
residual_risks.mitigation: Decision is EXPERIMENT; PR body and docs label reality status
residual_risks.review_trigger: any claim of completion without a live case

residual_risks.mitigation: INTENT-0031 records the exact wording, the translation and the open external wedge as NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION

dissent.handling: Preserved; does not block a draft experiment.

entries.position: Self-reported ladder outcomes weaken the anti-literalization gate
entries.evidence_threshold: Per-rung evidence references required and checked before a new_architecture candidate is admissible

migration_plan: Additive: new module, new tests, one new PartsBoard method, docs. No existing record types change. This record authorizes only the reversible sandbox experiment in draft PR #129. Merge follows normal founder review of the PR; any live case needs Gate grants for shadow and active bindings; neither is granted by this record.

steps: ledgers keep genesis records as history; PartsBoard ignores them

kill_criteria: A retained binding occurs without a Gate receipt
A forged or replayed decision record changes live state after restart
First live case shows the loop adds cost without changing any retain/regress decision a human would have made
Founder rules that formation cases must run through evolution.ClosureLoop instead
review_trigger: First live shadow case against a real local model on real signals, or founder review of PR #129
